fact: UNICEF's 2025 budget brief, citing the ministry's programme based budgets, states that the Births and Deaths Registry was fully funded by the Government of Ghana in 2020 and that by 2025 93% of its GHS 7,409,170 budget is financed from internally generated funds, with no development partner allocation in any year from 2020 to 2025.
title: Child Protection Budget Brief 2025
